Class BudgetManager

java.lang.Object
model.BudgetManager
public class BudgetManager extends Object
Handles all budget-related business logic including daily limits, spending calculations, category summaries, and budget tracking rules. This class acts as the main service layer for financial computations.

    • calculateDailyLimit

      public double calculateDailyLimit(BudgetCycle cycle, List<Transaction> transactions)
      FR-4 (Dynamic Safe Daily Limit) Calculates today's remaining safe spending limit. It subtracts today's spending from the initial daily limit.

      cycle - the budget cycle
      transactions - list of transactions
      Returns:
      remaining daily limit (minimum 0)
